sources.title: Fine-tune Llama 3.2 1B using AI Runtime - Azure Databricks
sources.snippet: Fully fine-tune a large language model with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on Databricks AI Runtime. The notebook uses the Transformers Reinforcement Learning (TRL) library with DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 optimization to efficiently train Llama 3.2 1B on a single node with 8 H100 GPUs.
